tech.title: Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.
tech.summary: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinical psychologists, they can represent something more sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders.
